name: CP-135,807
summary: CP-135807 is a pyrrolidinylmethylindole and cyclized tryptamine derivative which acts as a potent and selective agonist for the 5-HT1D serotonin receptor, and is used to study the function of this receptor subtype.

pharmacology.text: CP-135807 is a pyrrolidinylmethylindole and cyclized tryptamine derivative which acts as a potent and selective agonist for the 5-HT1D serotonin receptor, and is used to study the function of this receptor subtype.

uses.text: CP-135807 is a pyrrolidinylmethylindole and cyclized tryptamine derivative which acts as a potent and selective agonist for the 5-HT1D serotonin receptor, and is used to study the function of this receptor subtype.

fact.en: The 5-HT1D receptor it activates is one of the two main targets of the triptan migraine drugs, such as sumatriptan.
fact.zh: 它所活化的 5-HT1D 受體，是舒馬曲坦等翠普登類偏頭痛藥物的兩個主要作用目標之一。
fact.zhHans: 它所活化的 5-HT1D 受体，是舒马曲坦等翠普登类偏头痛药物的两个主要作用目标之一。
